test_title: SSC CHSL Exam 2023 Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 10 Jan, 2024 Shift 1).
subject: general
question: What will be given to a child if he gets a good name?
solution:
The correct answer is option 4 i.e. A head start in life.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **passage states** that a good name will give a child “a start in life equivalent to a cash capital of at least fifteen thousand dollars.” This means that a good name can provide a significant advantage or head start in life.
 
• **Option 1** is incorrect as the passage does not refer to a bank balance directly.
 
• **Option 2 **is incorrect as the passage does not mention anything about an address.
 
• **Option 3** is incorrect because there is no mention of a professional attitude being given by a good name in the passage.

Hence, the correct answer is option 4.
